_source: Extracted from TNPSC Advertisement No. 747, Notification No. 11/2026 (group_english.pdf, 85 pages). The official PDF is the source of truth; the English version is final per para 6.5.

notification.examName: Combined Civil Services Examination - IV (Group IV Services)
notification.helplineHours: 10.00 A.M to 5.45 P.M on all working days

summary.largestVacancyPost: Junior Assistant (Non Security), Tamil Nadu Ministerial Service

parts.subject: Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test
parts.gateNote: Part B and Part C are evaluated only if the candidate secures 60 marks (40%) in Part A. Part A questions are set in Tamil only.

parts.subject: General Studies
parts.marksNote: Part B and Part C together carry 150 marks

parts.subject: Aptitude and Mental Ability
parts.marksNote: Part B and Part C together carry 150 marks

differentlyAbledOption.note: Differently abled candidates (any percentage of disability) who studied only English at Board / University may write General English (SSLC standard) instead of the Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test. No translation part. Minimum qualifying marks 60 (40%). The Certificate of Disability in the Annexure V format must be uploaded with the online application.

fee.concessionNote: Special categories may claim fee exemption as per Annexure II. Each concession claim consumes one free chance. The Yes / No choice cannot be edited after submission.

eligibility.minimumGeneralEducationalQualification: A pass in the Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) Examination of Tamil Nadu
eligibility.qualificationCutoffDate: Must be possessed on the date of notification (06.10.2026)
eligibility.degreeOrderOfStudy: 10th + HSC / Diploma or equivalent + UG Degree
eligibility.tamilKnowledgeNote: Adequate knowledge of Tamil as on the notification date: SSLC / HSC / Degree with Tamil as one of the languages, or the High School course in Tamil medium, or a pass in the TNPSC Second Class Language Test (Full Test) in Tamil. Otherwise the test must be cleared within two years of appointment.

others.description: Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s and BCMs

reserved.description: SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s and BCMs

ageLimits.note: Several corporation and board posts carry no maximum age limit. See paras 4.1.1 and 4.1.2 of the notification for the exact post-wise table.

restrictions: Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s and BCMs who have completed five years or more of Government service since first appointment are not eligible, even if within the age limit.
Only persons professing the Hindu religion are eligible for posts in the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department.
Only persons professing the Muslim religion are eligible for Typist (3846) and Steno Typist Grade III (3847) in the Tamil Nadu Waqf Board.
Candidates with blindness and low vision are not eligible for posts in the Judicial Department / Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority.

steps: Single Stage Written Examination (OMR, 200 questions, 300 marks)
Onscreen Certificate Verification (1:3 general / 1:2 reserved for VAO, Junior Assistant, Typist and Steno Typist; 1:6 all categories for Forest Guard with Driving Licence and Forest Watcher)
Physical Standards Test and Endurance Test (Forest Guard with Driving Licence and Forest Watcher only, 1:3 ratio, at Chennai only)
tieBreakerOrder: Higher technical qualification (Typewriting / Shorthand) where prescribed

examCentres.selectionRule: Candidates may choose two preferred examination centres and will be allotted a venue in one of them. Candidates with benchmark disability choose only one centre.
examCentres.fullCentreListLocation: Para 3.7.4 / Annexure I of the Notification

steps: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) at www.tnpscexams.in
Link the Aadhaar number with the OTR (mandatory)
Fill the online application for Combined Civil Services Examination - IV
Choose the post option: All the Posts, or Posts other than Forest Guard with Driving Licence / Forest Watcher
Upload a photograph taken on or after the notification date, and a signature drawn in a 6.0 x 2.0 cm box
Pay Rs.100 online, or claim the fee concession if eligible
applicationProcess.otrNote: One Time Registration is not an application for any post. A valid e-mail ID and mobile number are mandatory.
applicationProcess.correctionWindow: 09.11.2026 to 11.11.2026 is the last chance to edit the application

bannedItems: Mobile phones, pagers, any electronic or programmable device
Smart / digital watches and watches with in-built memory
Rings with in-built memory, smart glasses / meta glasses
Design data books, mathematical and drawing instruments, log tables, stencils of maps, slide rules
